decisions.statement: Where a mark is written is read from the declarations the page type has.
A page type's body is read through the reader handed in rather than off the tree.
A mark whose key is declared uncommitted is written beside the account's page.
A mark whose key is declared secret is refused.
A mark whose key is declared neither uncommitted nor secret is refused.
A mark whose key the page type declares nowhere is refused.
A mark refused for its key is refused before any value of that mark is weighed.
A mark with no value to write leaves the page unchanged.
A mark value of null takes its key away from beside the page.
A number reaches the file beside the page as a number.
A mark with a newline is refused.
A mark holding text that is blank is refused.
A mark with a record is written beside the page as a record.
A field of a record mark has text or a finite number.
A record mark with no field is refused.
A record mark with a field named `__proto__` is refused.
A mark that is neither text nor a finite number nor a record nor a removal is refused.
An account no page is filed for is answered as absent.
Writing a mark answers with an outcome rather than throwing.
Writing one account's mark opens that account's page and no other account's page.
Writing one account's mark reads no index the whole fleet is filed in.
A mark is written under the key akasha declares that value as.
The at-limit mark is the moment handed in plus the backoff the OAuth module gives.
The subscription mark has the reason as the text that reason is.
A subscription mark with no reason takes the withdrawal away.
The pacing mark has each window's percentage used.
The pacing mark has each window's reset moment.
The pacing mark has each window's opening moment.
The pacing mark has the moment the usage was read.
A usage body the wire shape refuses is answered as no usage.
An instant outside the range a date holds is answered as no instant.
The repository root reaches every writer here as a parameter.
The reading of the index reaches this module as a parameter.
The reader of page bodies reaches this module as a parameter.
A caller names the account a mark is written for.
Every moment a mark carries is handed in by the caller.
A caller marking many accounts hands the routing in once.
Nothing here reads a clock.
Nothing here fetches.
Nothing here decrypts.
Nothing here writes a secret.
Nothing here writes into a page's own body.
No reader of a page body is built here from the root.
Nothing here lands a commit.
Nothing here reads a second account to mark the account named.
No routing is remembered between two marks.
No secret value is written to a log here.
A key declared both secret and uncommitted is routed as a secret.
A pacing mark whose reset is unknown takes the reset last written away.
A pacing mark built from a moment that will not read takes the read moment away.
Reading the routing lists the directory the page property types are filed under.
A refusal names the first key refused rather than every key refused.

definition: what is written down about a model-account
